scope: safe gateway v1 rejection corpus; not an observation of the legacy server

cases.name: truncated-gzip
cases.derivation: remove the final two bytes from any golden vector

cases.name: trailing-uncompressed-field
cases.derivation: append one byte inside the gzip member

cases.name: too-many-tasks
cases.expected: malformed gateway frame: too many tasks

cases.name: request-signature-tamper
cases.derivation: change route, sequence, nonce or body after HMAC-SHA256 signing

cases.name: timestamp-outside-clock-window
cases.derivation: set X-Specter-Timestamp more than five minutes from server time

cases.name: nonce-replay
cases.derivation: repeat an already accepted agent nonce

cases.name: tls-hostname-mismatch
cases.derivation: trust the issuing CA but connect with a hostname absent from the certificate SAN
